scenes.heading: Custom Step Components
scenes.narration: Workflows. Custom Step Components. In this video we review 8 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What does a workflow step component define for model authors?
scenes.heading: A workflow step component defines the step's authoring behavior, appearance, dialog, and runtime implementation
scenes.body: The speech says a workflow step component defines how a step looks and behaves when building models, including its category and name, appearance, edit dialog, and the service or script that runs at runtime.

scenes.question: Which base step resource super type should a custom automatic process step inherit from?
scenes.heading: cq/workflow/components/model/process
scenes.body: The speech lists the three base paths and says process steps inherit from cq/workflow/components/model/process.

scenes.question: If a custom step should choose the assignee at runtime, which base step should it extend?
scenes.heading: cq/workflow/components/model/dynamic_participant
scenes.body: The speech says the dynamic participant base path is cq/workflow/components/model/dynamic_participant.

scenes.question: Why should custom workflow step components never be modified under /libs?
scenes.heading: Never change /libs; recreate the item under /apps and change it there
scenes.body: The speech is explicit: never change anything in /libs; recreate the item under /apps and make the changes there.

scenes.question: Where do design-time defaults for a workflow step component belong?
scenes.heading: In cq:editConfig with child cq:formParameters
scenes.body: The speech says design-time defaults go in a cq:editConfig node of type cq:EditConfig, with a child node named cq:formParameters of type nt:unstructured.

scenes.question: Which cq:formParameters property fixes the implementation of a process step so model authors cannot change it?
scenes.heading: PROCESS fixes the process implementation
scenes.body: The speech says properties on cq:formParameters include PROCESS, PARTICIPANT, and DYNAMIC_PARTICIPANT, and that setting them removes the model author's ability to change the value.

scenes.question: For a participant step, which cq:formParameters property should be used to show a form when the user opens the work item?
scenes.heading: FORM_PATH shows a form when the user opens the work item
scenes.body: The speech says FORM_PATH is used to present a form when the user opens a work item, and that it applies to participant steps.
